text:
Maya (CEO): thanks for joining the Q&A thread — drop any follow-ups about the reorg/headcount and we'll respond.
Alex (Staff SWE): can managers expect fixed hiring tokens or rolling approvals? need to plan sprints.
Priya (Head of People): managers will get quarterly allocation tokens. some emergency top-ups available via a fast lane with finance signoff. we'll publish allocation dashboards next week.
Emma (Senior PM): will PM headcount be affected? last slide showed flat product hires but curious about TPM/PM splits.
Jonas (VP Eng): product hiring stays near-term flat; we're shifting a few junior PM roles to TPMs to improve cross-team delivery. senior PM hires remain selective and tied to revenue-driving initiatives.
Alex (Staff SWE): how are we handling impacted ICs during team merges? reassignments or open interviews?
Priya (Head of People): priority is placement. affected ICs will get reallocation offers first, with hiring support and ramp plans. if a role is removed, we offer a 60-day mobility window to find placement.
Maya (CEO): important to say: no surprise layoffs planned. this is about reshaping teams for product leverage and reliability wins.
hiring-bot: poll created "Do you feel comfortable with the org changes?" options: Yes / Somewhat / No
Priya (Head of People): follow-up: internal candidates are prioritized. managers — please review internal nom list before posting externally. Talent will host office hours Friday 9am PT.
Emma (Senior PM): any change to interview loop? can we expedite for critical roles?
Priya (Head of People): critical roles get a 2-week fast track; standard roles follow the 28-day target. updated rubrics in Confluence.
Maya (CEO): we'll post the updated org map by Thursday and run a town office hour next Tues. thanks all, keep questions concise here and we'll keep answering live.
